title: Syrian Beef Wrap
description: A flavorful and hearty beef wrap with a tangy twist, featuring a rich Syrian-inspired sauce.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the sirloin steak with salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Grill the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped leek and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Stir in the yogurt sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Warm the pita wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the steak onto each wrap, followed by a spoonful of the leek and yogurt sauce mixture.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
